ctaHeading: Ready for custom woodwork in Preston?
aboutText: Based in Preston, Charles Sandford Woodworking offers bespoke woodworking services for architecture, furniture, and restoration projects. With years of experience, our team delivers meticulous attention to detail for every job. We pride ourselves on quality, using traditional techniques to create pieces that last. Serving Preston and surrounds with trusted, custom solutions.
servicesText: From custom furniture to architectural woodwork, we provide tailored services for residential and commercial clients in Preston. Our expertise in restoration ensures cherished items are revived with care. We combine skill and passion to meet your unique woodworking needs.

services.title: Custom Furniture
services.desc: Designing and building unique furniture pieces to perfectly fit your space and style requirements.

services.title: Architectural Woodwork
services.desc: Creating custom wood elements like beams, trim, and fixtures for homes and buildings.

services.title: Restoration Projects
services.desc: Restoring antique and vintage wood items to their former glory with expert care and precision.

services.title: Cabinet Making
services.desc: Handcrafted cabinets for kitchens, bathrooms, and storage solutions tailored to your needs.

services.title: Joinery & Millwork
services.desc: Precision joinery for doors, windows, and custom woodwork installations with fine detailing.

services.title: Wood Finishing
services.desc: Applying high-quality finishes to protect and enhance the natural beauty of your wood projects.
